units.text: Article 33
units.label: Art. 33

units.text: Citizens of the Russian Federation have the right to apply personally and to submit individual and collective appeals to state bodies and local self-government bodies.
units.label: Art. 33 · text

units.text: Article 34
units.label: Art. 34

units.text: 1. Everyone has the right freely to use their abilities and property for entrepreneurial and other economic activity not prohibited by law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 34

units.text: 2. Economic activity directed at monopolization or unfair competition is not permitted.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 34

units.text: Article 35
units.label: Art. 35

units.text: 1. The right of private ownership is protected by law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 35

units.text: 2. Everyone is entitled to own property and to possess, use and dispose of it both individually and jointly with others.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 35

units.text: 3. No one may be deprived of their property except by a court decision. Property may be compulsorily alienated for state needs only subject to prior and equivalent compensation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 35

units.text: 4. The right of inheritance is guaranteed.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 35

units.text: Article 36
units.label: Art. 36

units.text: 1. Citizens and their associations are entitled to hold land in private ownership.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 36

units.text: 2. Owners freely possess, use and dispose of land and other natural resources, provided that this does not harm the environment or violate the rights and lawful interests of others.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 36

units.text: 3. The conditions and procedure for using land are determined on the basis of federal law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 36

units.text: Article 37
units.label: Art. 37

units.text: 1. Labour is free. Everyone has the right freely to dispose of their capacity for work and to choose their occupation and profession.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 37

units.text: 2. Forced labour is prohibited.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 37

units.text: 3. Everyone has the right to work in conditions meeting safety and hygiene requirements, to remuneration for work without any discrimination and not below the minimum wage established by federal law, and to protection against unemployment.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 37

units.text: 4. The right to individual and collective labour disputes using the means of settlement established by federal law, including the right to strike, is recognized.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 37

units.text: 5. Everyone has the right to rest. Persons working under an employment contract are guaranteed the working hours, days off, public holidays and paid annual leave established by federal law.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 37

units.text: Article 38
units.label: Art. 38

units.text: 1. Motherhood, childhood and the family are protected by the State.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 38

units.text: 2. Caring for and bringing up children is an equal right and duty of parents.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 38

units.text: 3. Able-bodied children who have reached 18 years of age must care for their parents who are unable to work.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 38

units.text: Article 39
units.label: Art. 39

units.text: 1. Everyone is guaranteed social security in old age, in the event of illness, disability or loss of a breadwinner, for bringing up children and in other cases established by law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 39

units.text: 2. State pensions and social benefits are established by law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 39

units.text: 3. Voluntary social insurance, the establishment of additional forms of social security and charity are encouraged.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 39

units.text: Article 40
units.label: Art. 40

units.text: 1. Everyone has the right to housing. No one may be arbitrarily deprived of housing.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 40

units.text: 2. Bodies of state authority and local self-government bodies encourage housing construction and create conditions for exercising the right to housing.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 40

units.text: 3. Low-income and other citizens specified by law who need housing are provided with it free of charge or at an affordable price from state, municipal and other housing stocks, in accordance with standards established by law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 40

units.text: Article 41
units.label: Art. 41

units.text: 1. Everyone has the right to health protection and medical care. Medical care in state and municipal healthcare institutions is provided to citizens free of charge, funded by the relevant budget, insurance contributions and other revenues.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 41

units.text: 2. In the Russian Federation, federal programmes to protect and improve public health are funded; measures are taken to develop state, municipal and private healthcare systems; and activities promoting human health, physical culture and sport, environmental well-being and sanitary and epidemiological well-being are encouraged.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 41

units.text: 3. Concealment by officials of facts and circumstances that threaten people's life and health entails liability under federal law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 41

units.text: Article 42
units.label: Art. 42

units.text: Everyone has the right to a favourable environment, reliable information about its condition and compensation for harm caused to their health or property by an environmental offence.
units.label: Art. 42 · text

units.text: Article 43
units.label: Art. 43

units.text: 1. Everyone has the right to education.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 43

units.text: 2. General accessibility and free provision of preschool, basic general and secondary vocational education in state or municipal educational institutions and at enterprises are guaranteed.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 43

units.text: 3. Everyone is entitled, on a competitive basis, to receive higher education free of charge in a state or municipal educational institution and at an enterprise.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 43

units.text: 4. Basic general education is compulsory. Parents or persons acting in their place ensure that children receive basic general education.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 43

units.text: 5. The Russian Federation establishes federal state educational standards and supports various forms of education and self-education.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 43

units.text: Article 44
units.label: Art. 44

units.text: 1. Everyone is guaranteed freedom of literary, artistic, scientific, technical and other creative activity and of teaching. Intellectual property is protected by law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 2. Everyone has the right to participate in cultural life, use cultural institutions and have access to cultural assets.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 44

units.text: 3. Everyone is obliged to care for the preservation of historical and cultural heritage and to safeguard historical and cultural monuments.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 44

units.text: Article 45
units.label: Art. 45

units.text: 1. State protection of human and civil rights and freedoms in the Russian Federation is guaranteed.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 45

units.text: 2. Everyone is entitled to protect their rights and freedoms by all means not prohibited by law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 45

units.text: Article 46
units.label: Art. 46

units.text: 1. Everyone is guaranteed judicial protection of their rights and freedoms.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 46

units.text: 2. Decisions and actions (or inaction) of bodies of state authority, local self-government bodies, public associations and officials may be challenged in court.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 46

units.text: 3. In accordance with international treaties of the Russian Federation, everyone is entitled to apply to intergovernmental bodies for the protection of human rights and freedoms if all available domestic legal remedies have been exhausted.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 46

units.text: Article 47
units.label: Art. 47

units.text: 1. No one may be deprived of the right to have their case heard by the court and judge to whose jurisdiction it is assigned by law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 47

units.text: 2. A person accused of a crime has the right to have their case heard by a court sitting with a jury in cases provided for by federal law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 47

units.text: Article 48
units.label: Art. 48

units.text: 1. Everyone is guaranteed the right to qualified legal assistance. Legal assistance is provided free of charge in cases prescribed by law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 48

units.text: 2. Every person detained, remanded in custody or accused of a crime has the right to the assistance of a lawyer (defence counsel) from the time of detention, remand in custody or the bringing of charges, respectively.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 48

units.text: Article 49
units.label: Art. 49

units.text: 1. Everyone accused of a crime is presumed innocent until their guilt is proved in the manner prescribed by federal law and established by a court judgment that has entered into legal force.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 49

units.text: 2. The accused is not obliged to prove their innocence.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 49
